proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no NMS, target text, target identity, target box, or truth access.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 once to every retained proposal.

geometry.pair_score: Geometric mean of depth-consistent proposal-mask coverage in both directions.
geometry.candidate_score: Rank depth-supported candidates first, then any mutual-best edge, maximum symmetric track score, objectness, and frozen proposal index.

literature_motivation.name: Boundary Exploration NBV
literature_motivation.use: Preserve sufficient view overlap while adding a nontrivial baseline.

literature_motivation.name: MV3DIS
literature_motivation.use: Associate masks through depth-consistent 3D evidence rather than correlated appearance scores.

gate.requirements: Under the already-frozen row3 region gate, all three frames must offer IoU>=0.8 and geometry Top-3 must cover IoU>=0.8 in all three.

next_action: Seal the consumed Development negative; do not tune selector bounds or track scoring on row 3.
claim_boundary: This consumed-family Development test evaluates only whether replacing a zero-covisibility action restores bounded target-region candidate coverage. It does not establish source-disjoint generalization, target ownership, portal access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, or safety.
